selection_scope: Chosen before training: two selected flops with complete ordered future candidates, three-chip stacks, live open/limp-raise-to-two, default flop actions, forced checkdown afterward. Keep every checkpoint and every target miss. T250 is below unchanged 3-million world-iteration admission (11880*250=2970000). No equivalence or performance comparison to the rejected all-streets game.
model_limits: Finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop game with narrow ranges and no turn/river choices. No all-streets equilibrium, full-deck preflop, unrestricted NLHE or general performance claim.
